title: Pure Kuriboh
summary: Kuriboh cards with Five Star Twilight and generic staples. The page's hybrid builds add Dark Magician and Fusion engines, so they use cards this list leaves out. Kuribabylon is the Level 5 that Five Star Twilight Tributes to summon all five Kuriboh brothers, and Kuribabylon itself returns to the hand to summon them again. Kuriboh - Multiply!, the newest card, summons itself when the opponent attacks or activates a monster effect and calls another 300/200 monster from the Deck. Winged Kuriboh Sabatiel LV10 is left out: its search wants a Fusion engine and locks you to HERO Extra Deck monsters.
main: Kuriboh - Multiply!
Newest support. Summons itself on their attack or monster effect; calls a 300/200 monster from the Deck or GY and zeroes their monster.
Kuribabylon
Level 5 for Five Star Twilight; returns to the hand to summon all five brothers.
Kuriboh
One of the five; Flute of Summoning Kuriboh fetches it.
Kuribah
One of the five: summons a 300/200 monster when a Kuriboh is destroyed in battle.
Kuribee
One of the five: searches a Kuriboh Spell/Trap, and negates an attack.
Kuribeh
One of the five: discards to pump a Kuriboh by 1500.
Kuriboo
One of the five: discards on an attack to search a Kuriboh monster.
Darkuriboh
2026 support. Discards to protect a Fiend from destruction and negation; sent from the hand, adds Polymerization.
Detonating Kuriboh
Summons itself next to a Kuriboh; equips to their monster to negate it.
Sphere Kuriboh
Discards to switch an attacker to Defense Position.
Kuribohrn
Revives the Kuribohs from the GY when they attack.
Relinkuriboh
Draws when Tributed; saves a monster from battle.
Clear Kuriboh
Negates a burn effect; draws on a direct attack.
Kuribandit
Excavates five for a Spell/Trap, filling the GY for Kuribabylon.
Five Star Twilight
Tributes a lone Level 5 to summon all five Kuriboh brothers from anywhere.
The Flute of Summoning Kuriboh
Adds or summons Kuriboh or Winged Kuriboh from the Deck.
Multiply
Tributes Kuriboh for a field of Kuriboh Tokens.
extra: Limited. Link-1 for a Level 1: zeroes an attacker and comes back from the GY.
